AUTH.TITLE: Choose a channel
AUTH.DESC: Chatwoot supports live-chat widgets, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Emails, etc., as channels. If you want to build a custom channel, you can create it using the API channel. To get started, choose one of the channels below.

AGENTS.TITLE: Agents
AGENTS.DESC:
Here you can add agents to manage your newly created inbox. Only these selected agents will have access to your inbox. Agents which are not part of this inbox will not be able to see or respond to messages in this inbox when they login.
PS: As an administrator, if you need access to all inboxes, you should add yourself as agent to all inboxes that you create.
AGENTS.VALIDATION_ERROR: Add at least one agent to your new Inbox

DETAILS.TITLE: Inbox Details
DETAILS.DESC: From the dropdown below, select the Facebook Page you want to connect to Chatwoot. You can also give a custom name to your inbox for better identification.

FINISH.TITLE: Nailed It!
FINISH.DESC:
You have successfully finished integrating your Facebook Page with Chatwoot. Next time a customer messages your Page, the conversation will automatically appear on your inbox.
We are also providing you with a widget script that you can easily add to your website. Once this is live on your website, customers can message you right from your website without the help of any external tool and the conversation will appear right here, on Chatwoot.
Cool, huh? Well, we sure try to be :)

EMAIL_PROVIDER.TITLE: Select your email provider
EMAIL_PROVIDER.DESCRIPTION: Select an email provider from the list below. If you don't see your email provider in the list, you can select the other provider option and provide the IMAP and SMTP Credentials.

AGENTS.TITLE: Mga Ahente
AGENTS.DESC:
Dito maaari kang magdagdag ng mga ahente upang pamahalaan ang iyong bagong likhang inbox. Tanging ang mga napiling ahenteng ito lamang ang magkakaroon ng access sa iyong inbox. Ang mga ahenteng hindi bahagi ng inbox na ito ay hindi makakakita o makakasagot sa mga mensahe sa inbox na ito kapag nag-login sila.
PS: Bilang isang administrador, kung kailangan mo ng access sa lahat ng inbox, dapat mong idagdag ang iyong sarili bilang ahente sa lahat ng inbox na iyong nilikha.

DETAILS.TITLE: Mga Detalye ng Inbox

FINISH.TITLE: Tama na!
FINISH.DESC:
Matagumpay mong natapos ang pag-integrate ng iyong Facebook Page sa Chatwoot. Sa susunod na mag-message ang isang customer sa iyong Pahina, awtomatikong lalabas ang pag-uusap sa iyong inbox.
Nagbibigay din kami sa iyo ng widget script na madali mong maidadagdag sa iyong website. Kapag ito ay live na sa iyong website, maaaring mag-message ang mga customer nang direkta mula sa iyong website nang hindi na kailangan ng anumang panlabas na tool at lalabas ang pag-uusap dito mismo, sa Chatwoot.
Astig, di ba? Sinisikap talaga namin :)
